about_the_game:
Filled Up is a 1st-person survival horror/comedy hybrid featuring LGBT characters and themes. Players take on the role of our hero, one of four friends that stumbled their way into the mysterious town of Hunksville after a horrific accident. Developed from the ground up using the Unreal 5 engine, players will experience unsurpassed graphical fidelity and character models bordering on the photo-realistic.  As you navigate through the town, players must use their wits, logic, and even luck to not only peel back centuries of unspoken secrets and unveil the shocking (and hilarious) truth behind Hunksville, but ultimately save your remaining friends. Along the way, you'll encounter hot horrors determined to impede and even end your journey. Players must muster every ounce of courage, wits, and determination to save not only your friends, but the very soul of the town of Hunksville itself. 

  • Immersive, first-person perspective - players will see the world through the eyes of our hero and experience the hilarious horrors first-hand.

  • Magical/mystical combat - guns do not exist in the town of Hunksville. Players must uncover its secrets and ultimately learn and attain various elemental spells to combat the countless denizens of the town. 

  • Unprecedented character detail - players will witness character models in unprecedented detail; the town of Hunksville has imposed mandatory gym memberships on all its citizens, and players will see the results of such a quirky requirement.

  • Comedy galore - players will be quite amused upon discovering the events leading to the founding of Hunksville. Moreover, the town's mayor had a unique rise to power that players won't soon forget.

content_descriptors.notes: Features scantily clad images of muscular males.
